items.title: Anthropic’s Dario Amodei calls accusations of surrendering human control to AI ‘absurd’
items.summary: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei pushes back against rivals’ accusations that he favors surrendering human agency to AI, even as leading AI companies increasingly automate their own research and model development.

items.summary: Chip restrictions, anti-distillation measures, and shrinking access to Nvidia hardware abroad are putting growing pressure on Deepseek, Moonshot AI, and Alibaba, according to a report. Deepseek researchers internally estimate they're already up to nine months behind US models, and the gap is widening....

items.title: AI agents now control part of Deepmind's compute for Gemini experiments, but recursive self-improvement remains distant
items.summary: Google Deepmind uses AI agents to run experiments on their own for upcoming Gemini models. Research chief Koray Kavukcuoglu says the lab is still far from recursive self-improvement. For oversight, Deepmind intentionally leaves the agents' internal chains of thought untrained so they can be reviewed. Kavukcuoglu measures AGI by everyday user trust rather than benchmarks....

items.title: DeepMind's Gemini Robotics 2.5 Aims to Make Robots Safer, More Dexterous, and Faster Learners
items.summary: Google DeepMind introduced Gemini Robotics 2.5, a vision-language-action (VLA) model designed to improve robots' dexterity, reliability, and learning speed, while enabling safer operation in unstructured real-world environments. By Sergio De Simone

items.title: Even the best AI agents struggle with everyday life
items.summary: As millions embrace personal AI assistants, a new benchmark reveals that even the most advanced AI models struggle to complete everyday tasks reliably and safely without introducing potential new problems.

items.title: Clay helps sales teams win with Codex and ChatGPT
items.summary: ChatGPT and Codex integrations help Clay’s users research deals and turn data into go-to-market plays, with GPT-6 models handling the reasoning.

items.title: GPT-6 models demonstrate intrinsic protein-design capabilities
items.summary: GPT-6 models design protein structures and sequences using reasoning and code. Lab tests found evidence of binding across five targets.

items.title: OpenAI says heavy ChatGPT users may hit limits sooner as it merges Chat and Work
items.summary: OpenAI will introduce a single usage meter across ChatGPT as it combines the Chat and Work experiences.

items.title: Anthropic study shows the hardest part of adopting AI at work has little to do with learning the tools
items.summary: Anthropic studied nearly 300 AI deployments across 58 US companies with sobering results. Nearly one in five still delivers no business value, held back by heavy review workloads, internal bottlenecks, and employee resistance. The researchers say the biggest hurdles stem from outdated company structures....

items.title: OpenAI wants companies to trust it with sensitive work by promising not to look at their data
items.summary: OpenAI is testing a new feature called "Private Inference" that lets companies run queries on its most powerful models without OpenAI being able to access the data. The article OpenAI wants companies to trust it with sensitive work by promising not to look at their data appeared first on The Decoder .
